description: This file defines the Document class within the OpenCart framework, providing methods to manage webpage meta information such as title, description, keywords, links, styles, scripts, and meta tags.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: A class for managing various HTML document head elements such as title, meta tags, links, styles, and scripts within the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: addLink
methods.description: Adds a link tag to the document head with specified href and rel attributes.

methods.name: addStyle
methods.description: Adds a stylesheet link to the document head with optional rel and media attributes.

methods.name: addScript
methods.description: Adds a script source URL to the document.

methods.name: addMeta
methods.description: Adds a meta tag with specified attributes such as name, property, content, and media.
